answer_1.quote: The most advanced text-generation AI models, called large language models (LLMs), are able to generate high-quality texts in various languages.
answer_1.outputs: social-media texts in multiple languages and platforms

answer_2.quote: We have conducted linguistic analysis of the machine-generated texts along with the similarity comparison to human texts... reported in Table 3.

answer_3.quote: We have used meta-evaluation utilizing LLM judges to compare the quality of the generated texts of individual generators to the quality of original human texts...

answer_4.quote: We have even conducted manual human check of the generated texts, resulting in identification of various phrases indicating noise in the data...
answer_4.guideline: identification of noise such as 'as an ai model', 'language model', 'instruction', 'task', etc., and assessment of text quality based on fluency and naturalness
